markers: | description = You gain a +1 bonus to {{attack roll|melee unarmed}}s and damage.

sources.title: Unhampered Resistance
markers: | description = While the wielder is not wearing armour, they receive a +2 bonus to {{SavingThrow}}s.

summary: Gain +1 to melee unarmed attack and damage rolls and +2 to saves while unarmoured.

fields.Natural Pugilist: +1 to melee unarmed attack rolls and damage.
fields.Unhampered Resistance: +2 to saving throws while wearing no armour. A shield is allowed. The pinned source reports Helldusk Armour and Elven Chain can bypass the armour restriction.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
